_comment: Building styles. 'kind' selects a geometry builder in code (gable | gambrel | leanto) — you can tune 'params' freely, but a NEW kind needs code. Pitches are rise/run: a 4/12 roof is 0.3333. Sizes are the ones you actually sell; every size here must have a row in pricing.json or the validator will tell you.

styles.name: Utility
styles.blurb: The workhorse. Straight walls, simple gable roof, maximum floor for the money.

styles.name: Lofted Barn
styles.blurb: The classic barn silhouette. The gambrel roof buys you real loft storage overhead.

styles.name: Lean-To
styles.blurb: Single slope, low profile. Sits tight against a fence line or an existing building.
